// Generated by p6-citations.py; exact callback bodies, visibility only.
use aspis_core::Digest32;
const BINARY_NODE_TAG:u8=0x12;
const MAX_BATCH:usize=16;
pub fn binary_parent<H: Digest32>(hash: H, left: &[u8; 32], right: &[u8; 32]) -> [u8; 32] {
    hash.digest(&[&[BINARY_NODE_TAG], left, right])
}
pub(crate) fn occupied_binary_parent<H: Digest32>(hash: H, values: &[[u8; 32]; MAX_BATCH], index: usize) -> [u8; 32] {
    hash.digest(&[&[BINARY_NODE_TAG], &values[index], &values[index + 1]])
}
pub(crate) fn sibling_binary_parent<H: Digest32>(hash: H, values: &[[u8; 32]; MAX_BATCH], index: usize, sibling: &[u8], left: bool) -> [u8; 32] {
    if left { hash.digest(&[&[BINARY_NODE_TAG], &values[index], sibling]) }
    else { hash.digest(&[&[BINARY_NODE_TAG], sibling, &values[index]]) }
}
